title: How AI text watermarking works
excerpt: A gentle visual guide to how a statistical mark hides inside generated text, and what erases it.
content_html:
← declaude

A watermark in plain text sounds impossible. Text has no pixels to hide data in, and no metadata survives copy-and-paste; every character is right there in front of you. Where could a mark possibly go?

And yet the marks are real. Google has watermarked text from the Gemini app and web experience since 2024 (its API is, at the time of writing, a documented exception), and as of August 2026, new Claude models mark text at the model level, with earlier models to follow. They're invisible, they survive copying, and they work because they don't live in the characters at all. They live in the choices between words.

1. Writing is a series of small choices

The one idea in this step: a model writes by rolling weighted dice between several words that would each be fine.

When a model is mid-sentence, it doesn't know "the next word." It has a shortlist, like autocomplete, with preferences. Here's a real kind of moment, one word from the end of a sentence:

the sentence being written

The results of the study were quite  

Each roll sweeps the shortlist, lands on one word (odds matching the bars) and drops it into the sentence above. The dots tally where the rolls land: try ×20 and watch the pile take the shape of the odds. Notice what never changes: every landing makes a perfectly good sentence.

A page of text contains hundreds of these little forks, one per word, and at many of them several options are equally fine. That slack is the raw material. Whoever gets to lean on how the dice land can hide a pattern in the text without changing what it says.

2. A secret key leans on those choices

The one idea in this step: the key secretly colours the shortlist and gives one colour a gentle nudge. The text still reads normally.

Here is the classic recipe (Kirchenbauer et al. 2023; Google's SynthID reaches the same end by a subtler, tournament-style route). At each fork, secret-keyed maths splits the candidate words into green and red, an arbitrary colouring only the key-holder can reproduce. Then the dice get tilted a little toward green.

the sentence being written

The results of the study were quite  

No key applied: these are the model's own preferences. Dashed outlines will show the old odds once the key is on.

Two things make this sneaky. The nudge is mild: a red word can still win — it's just a little less likely. And the colouring is not a fixed property of the word: the key computes it from a short run of the words just before, so the same candidate is green after one prefix and red after another:

The same four candidate words, coloured by the key after six different prefixes. The key sees the words just before it; the position in the wider text is invisible to it. Only the overall lean toward green accumulates, and only the key-holder knows which words were green where.

(Two siblings, same principle. Google's SynthID — the one in production — replaces the nudge with a tiny secret tournament: a few candidates are drawn from the model's own odds, the key scores them, and the bracket is arranged so that, averaged over the key's draws, every word's odds stay exactly what the model intended. Aaronson's scheme, built at OpenAI, skips even that and derives the dice-rolls themselves from the key. Different maths, same principle: the mark lives in the choices.)

3. Whoever holds the key can count

The one idea in this step: with the key, you can re-colour any text and simply count. Marked text lands green too often to be luck.

Detection doesn't read the text or judge its style. The detector replays the key-holder's colouring over the words and counts how many came up green. Without a mark (or without the right key), green should win about half the time. A coin flip. Here's an ordinary-looking paragraph; try both keys on it:

greens: – of 55

coin flip

flag bar (this length)

Filled-and-underlined chips are green, dashed outlines are red. The words read identically either way; the colouring exists only in the key-holder's maths. With the wrong key the split is meaningless, and the count sits at chance.

(This demo's tilt is drawn strong so you can see it; a production mark leans far more gently and needs correspondingly more text. In this demo's 50/50 model, a 1,500-word document would flag at only ~55% green: small leans become persuasive only through length, which is why short texts are genuinely hard to call.)

4. What editing does to the mark

The one idea in this step: the mark lives in runs of untouched wording. Editing erases it exactly where the runs break, and nowhere else.

Each word's colouring is derived from a short run of the words just before it (one to a handful, depending on the scheme). So a position only counts as evidence if a short window of the original wording (the word plus its neighbours) survives intact.

Here is the same paragraph from step 3, at five edit depths. Drag the slider and watch the highlighted runs shrink. A highlight means that run of wording still matches the original exactly, so the detector can count there. Everything faded is new wording, where there is nothing but coin-flip noise left to count.

fix typos · surviving windows: –%

The verdict reads the surviving fraction measured from the highlights above, projected to a 1,500-word document. Two things to notice: how much a "heavy edit" leaves standing, and how far toward a full rewrite you have to drag before the evidence actually dies.

On real implementations (MarkLLM's KGW and EXP schemes on an open model, washed by declaude's full-rewrite route): about 0.5% of windows survive, and detector accuracy falls from essentially certain to a coin flip. The published literature agrees on the shape of this. Light or one-pass paraphrase dilutes the mark rather than deleting it; in Kirchenbauer et al.'s experiments, the detector recovers given enough text, with even human paraphrase becoming detectable again after roughly 800 tokens (about 600 words). What removes the mark is re-composition that shares no runs of wording with the original.

That is why a tool that rewrites from the meaning (like declaude's full-rewrite route) is what actually erases this family of marks, and why a light pass that keeps most of the phrasing does not.

One boundary stated plainly: those numbers come from open implementations we can measure. Anthropic's production scheme is undisclosed, so no one outside Anthropic can yet run this test against Claude's own mark.

5. What this means in practice

The one idea in this step: detection is private, probabilistic, and about processing, not authorship.

  • Only the key-holder can check. Your teacher, editor, or favourite "AI detector" website cannot run this test; a genuine check needs the provider's secret key, or a checking service the provider runs. Google runs an early-access detector portal for SynthID; Anthropic says detection tooling is forthcoming.
  • A watermark check is not an "AI detector." Tools like GPTZero guess from style and are famously unreliable. A watermark is the opposite: a deliberate, key-gated statistical test. Don't let the two blur.
  • A found mark means "processed by", not "written by". Anthropic's own documentation notes that human text merely proofread or translated by Claude picks up the mark. And absence proves even less: old models or heavy editing yield clean results on genuine AI text.
  • Short and low-choice text carries little mark. Evidence grows with length, and text with only one right continuation (code, quotations, lists of facts) offers the dice too little slack to hide anything in.
  • Certain marks outlive a rewrite. Schemes keyed on the word itself rather than its neighbours hold up far better: a same-meaning rewrite keeps enough of the words that much of the mark survives. (Their weakness is different: a colouring reused everywhere can be reverse-engineered from enough output.) Others hide in the meaning, and a same-meaning rewrite partly preserves them; the only answer we know there is outline-level regeneration.

Written by James Padolsey at NOPE as an accompaniment to declaude. The interactive figures are a teaching model with illustrative parameters, not any provider's actual scheme.

Sources & further reading. Kirchenbauer et al., A Watermark for Large Language Models (ICML 2023) · Dathathri et al., Scalable watermarking for identifying LLM outputs (SynthID-Text, Nature 2024) · Aaronson & Kirchner, Watermarking GPT outputs (2022) · Kirchenbauer et al., On the Reliability of Watermarks for Large Language Models (ICLR 2024) · Sadasivan et al., Can AI-Generated Text be Reliably Detected? (2023) · Zhao et al., The Mark Fades: Adaptive Evolutionary Paraphrase-based Attack (ACL Findings 2026) · Anthropic, How Claude marks AI-generated content (Help Center, Aug 2026) · Our own known-key experiments: re-composition collapses KGW/EXP detection to chance (AUC 0.99 → ≈0.5), context-free unigram marks survive (0.73–0.84); outline-level regeneration is the only answer we know for meaning-space marks.

For the specialist: the residual-evidence model behind the step-4 verdict is z ≈ f·√N·z₁ (surviving fraction f, document length N, per-token strength z₁). The figures count words; real detectors count tokens in the model's own tokenizer. Same shape.

sentences.zh: 谁掌握了钥匙，谁就可以数数

blocks.html_en: The one idea in this step: with the key, you can re-colour any text and simply count. Marked text lands green too often to be luck.

sentences.en: The one idea in this step: with the key, you can re-colour any text and simply count.
sentences.zh: 这一步的一个想法是：使用 key，您可以为任何文本重新着色并简单地计数。

sentences.en: Marked text lands green too often to be luck.
sentences.zh: 标记的文本经常变成绿色，这并不是运气。

blocks.html_en: Detection doesn't read the text or judge its style. The detector replays the key-holder's colouring over the words and counts how many came up green. Without a mark (or without the right key), green should win about half the time. A coin flip. Here's an ordinary-looking paragraph; try both keys on it:

sentences.en: Detection doesn't read the text or judge its style.
sentences.zh: 检测不会读取文本或判断其风格。

sentences.en: The detector replays the key-holder's colouring over the words and counts how many came up green.
sentences.zh: 检测器会重放钥匙扣在单词上的颜色，并计算有多少个单词显示为绿色。

sentences.en: Without a mark (or without the right key), green should win about half the time.
sentences.zh: 如果没有标记（或没有正确的钥匙），绿色应该赢得大约一半的机会。

sentences.en: A coin flip.
sentences.zh: 抛硬币。

sentences.en: Here's an ordinary-looking paragraph; try both keys on it:
sentences.zh: 这是一个看起来很普通的段落；尝试使用两个键：

blocks.html_en: greens: – of 55

sentences.en: greens: – of 55

blocks.html_en: coin flip

sentences.en: coin flip
sentences.zh: 抛硬币

blocks.html_en: flag bar (this length)

sentences.en: flag bar (this length)
sentences.zh: 旗杆（这个长度）

blocks.html_en: Filled-and-underlined chips are green, dashed outlines are red. The words read identically either way; the colouring exists only in the key-holder's maths. With the wrong key the split is meaningless, and the count sits at chance.

sentences.en: Filled-and-underlined chips are green, dashed outlines are red.
sentences.zh: 填充和下划线的芯片为绿色，虚线轮廓为红色。

sentences.en: The words read identically either way; the colouring exists only in the key-holder's maths.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种方式，这些词读起来都是一样的。颜色只存在于钥匙持有者的数学中。

sentences.en: With the wrong key the split is meaningless, and the count sits at chance.
sentences.zh: 如果密钥错误，分裂就毫无意义，计数也只能靠运气。

blocks.html_en: (This demo's tilt is drawn strong so you can see it; a production mark leans far more gently and needs correspondingly more text. In this demo's 50/50 model, a 1,500-word document would flag at only ~55% green: small leans become persuasive only through length, which is why short texts are genuinely hard to call.)

sentences.en: (This demo's tilt is drawn strong so you can see it; a production mark leans far more gently and needs correspondingly more text.
sentences.zh: （此演示的倾斜度被绘制得很强烈，因此您可以看到它；生产标记倾斜得更柔和，因此需要相应更多的文本。

sentences.en: In this demo's 50/50 model, a 1,500-word document would flag at only ~55% green: small leans become persuasive only through length, which is why short texts are genuinely hard to call.)
sentences.zh: 在这个演示的 50/50 模型中，一份 1,500 字的文档只会被标记为大约 55% 的绿色：小的倾斜只有通过长度才能变得有说服力，这就是为什么短文本确实很难调用。）

blocks.html_en: 4. What editing does to the mark

sentences.en: What editing does to the mark
sentences.zh: 编辑对标记有何作用

blocks.html_en: The one idea in this step: the mark lives in runs of untouched wording. Editing erases it exactly where the runs break, and nowhere else.

sentences.en: The one idea in this step: the mark lives in runs of untouched wording.
sentences.zh: 这一步的一个想法是：标记存在于一系列未受影响的措辞中。

sentences.en: Editing erases it exactly where the runs break, and nowhere else.
sentences.zh: 编辑会准确地删除运行中断的地方，而不是其他地方。

blocks.html_en: Each word's colouring is derived from a short run of the words just before it (one to a handful, depending on the scheme). So a position only counts as evidence if a short window of the original wording (the word plus its neighbours) survives intact.

sentences.en: Each word's colouring is derived from a short run of the words just before it (one to a handful, depending on the scheme).
sentences.zh: 每个单词的颜色都源自其之前的一小部分单词（一个到几个，具体取决于方案）。

sentences.en: So a position only counts as evidence if a short window of the original wording (the word plus its neighbours) survives intact.
sentences.zh: 因此，只有原始措辞（该词及其相邻词）的一小部分完好无损地保留下来，该立场才算作证据。

blocks.html_en: Here is the same paragraph from step 3, at five edit depths. Drag the slider and watch the highlighted runs shrink. A highlight means that run of wording still matches the original exactly, so the detector can count there. Everything faded is new wording, where there is nothing but coin-flip noise left to count.

sentences.en: Here is the same paragraph from step 3, at five edit depths.
sentences.zh: 这是步骤 3 中的同一段落，有五个编辑深度。

sentences.en: Drag the slider and watch the highlighted runs shrink.
sentences.zh: 拖动滑块并观察突出显示的运行缩小。

sentences.en: A highlight means that run of wording still matches the original exactly, so the detector can count there.
sentences.zh: 突出显示意味着该行文字仍然与原始文字完全匹配，因此检测器可以在那里进行计数。

sentences.en: Everything faded is new wording, where there is nothing but coin-flip noise left to count.
sentences.zh: 一切褪色的都是新的措辞，除了抛硬币的噪音之外什么也没有。

blocks.html_en: fix typos · surviving windows: –%

sentences.en: fix typos · surviving windows: –%
sentences.zh: 修复拼写错误·幸存窗口：–%

blocks.html_en: The verdict reads the surviving fraction measured from the highlights above, projected to a 1,500-word document. Two things to notice: how much a "heavy edit" leaves standing, and how far toward a full rewrite you have to drag before the evidence actually dies.

sentences.en: The verdict reads the surviving fraction measured from the highlights above, projected to a 1,500-word document.
sentences.zh: 判决书读取了根据上述要点测量的幸存分数，并将其投影到一份 1,500 字的文档中。

sentences.en: Two things to notice: how much a "heavy edit" leaves standing, and how far toward a full rewrite you have to drag before the evidence actually dies.
sentences.zh: 需要注意两件事：“大量编辑”留下了多少痕迹，以及在证据真正消亡之前你必须拖到完全重写的程度。

blocks.html_en: On real implementations (MarkLLM's KGW and EXP schemes on an open model, washed by declaude's full-rewrite route): about 0.5% of windows survive, and detector accuracy falls from essentially certain to a coin flip. The published literature agrees on the shape of this. Light or one-pass paraphrase dilutes the mark rather than deleting it; in Kirchenbauer et al.'s experiments, the detector recovers given enough text, with even human paraphrase becoming detectable again after roughly 800 tokens (about 600 words). What removes the mark is re-composition that shares no runs of wording with the original.

sentences.en: On real implementations (MarkLLM's KGW and EXP schemes on an open model, washed by declaude's full-rewrite route): about 0.5% of windows survive, and detector accuracy falls from essentially certain to a coin flip.
sentences.zh: 在实际实现中（MarkLLM 在开放模型上的 KGW 和 EXP 方案，由 declaude 的完全重写路线清洗）：大约 0.5% 的窗口幸存下来，检测器精度从基本确定下降到抛硬币。

sentences.en: The published literature agrees on the shape of this.
sentences.zh: 已发表的文献对此的形式表示同意。

sentences.en: Light or one-pass paraphrase dilutes the mark rather than deleting it; in Kirchenbauer et al.'s experiments, the detector recovers given enough text, with even human paraphrase becoming detectable again after roughly 800 tokens (about 600 words).
sentences.zh: 轻微或一次性的释义会淡化标记，而不是删除它；在 Kirchenbauer 等人的实验中，检测器可以在给定足够文本的情况下恢复，甚至在大约 800 个标记（约 600 个单词）后，甚至可以再次检测到人类的释义。

sentences.en: What removes the mark is re-composition that shares no runs of wording with the original.
sentences.zh: 消除标记的是重新构图，与原作没有任何措辞。

blocks.html_en: That is why a tool that rewrites from the meaning (like declaude's full-rewrite route) is what actually erases this family of marks, and why a light pass that keeps most of the phrasing does not.

sentences.en: That is why a tool that rewrites from the meaning (like declaude's full-rewrite route) is what actually erases this family of marks, and why a light pass that keeps most of the phrasing does not.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么从含义重写的工具（如 declaude 的完全重写路线）实际上会删除这组标记，而保留大部分措辞的轻量级却不会。

blocks.html_en: One boundary stated plainly: those numbers come from open implementations we can measure. Anthropic's production scheme is undisclosed, so no one outside Anthropic can yet run this test against Claude's own mark.

sentences.en: One boundary stated plainly: those numbers come from open implementations we can measure.
sentences.zh: 一个界限清楚地表明：这些数字来自我们可以测量的开放实现。

sentences.en: Anthropic's production scheme is undisclosed, so no one outside Anthropic can yet run this test against Claude's own mark.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 的生产方案尚未公开，因此 Anthropic 之外的任何人都无法针对 Claude 自己的标记进行这项测试。

blocks.html_en: 5. What this means in practice

sentences.en: What this means in practice
sentences.zh: 这在实践中意味着什么

blocks.html_en: The one idea in this step: detection is private, probabilistic, and about processing, not authorship.

sentences.en: The one idea in this step: detection is private, probabilistic, and about processing, not authorship.
sentences.zh: 这一步的一个想法是：检测是私密的、概率性的，并且是关于处理的，而不是作者身份。

blocks.html_en: • Only the key-holder can check. Your teacher, editor, or favourite "AI detector" website cannot run this test; a genuine check needs the provider's secret key, or a checking service the provider runs. Google runs an early-access detector portal for SynthID; Anthropic says detection tooling is forthcoming.

sentences.en: Only the key-holder can check.
sentences.zh: 只有钥匙持有者才能检查。

sentences.en: Your teacher, editor, or favourite "AI detector" website cannot run this test; a genuine check needs the provider's secret key, or a checking service the provider runs.
sentences.zh: 您的老师、编辑或最喜欢的“AI 检测器”网站无法运行此测试；真正的检查需要提供者的密钥，或者提供者运行的检查服务。

sentences.en: Google runs an early-access detector portal for SynthID; Anthropic says detection tooling is forthcoming.
sentences.zh: Google 为 SynthID 运行了一个早期访问检测器门户； Anthropic 表示检测工具即将推出。

blocks.html_en: • A watermark check is not an "AI detector." Tools like GPTZero guess from style and are famously unreliable. A watermark is the opposite: a deliberate, key-gated statistical test. Don't let the two blur.

sentences.en: A watermark check is not an "AI detector."
sentences.zh: 水印检查不是“人工智能检测器”。

sentences.en: Tools like GPTZero guess from style and are famously unreliable.
sentences.zh: 像 GPTZero 这样的工具会根据风格进行猜测，并且众所周知是不可靠的。

sentences.en: A watermark is the opposite: a deliberate, key-gated statistical test.
sentences.zh: 水印则相反：一种经过深思熟虑的、关键门控的统计测试。

sentences.en: Don't let the two blur.
sentences.zh: 别让两者混淆了。

blocks.html_en: • A found mark means "processed by", not "written by". Anthropic's own documentation notes that human text merely proofread or translated by Claude picks up the mark. And absence proves even less: old models or heavy editing yield clean results on genuine AI text.

sentences.en: A found mark means "processed by", not "written by".
sentences.zh: 找到的标记意味着“由……处理”，而不是“由……编写”。

sentences.en: Anthropic's own documentation notes that human text merely proofread or translated by Claude picks up the mark.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 自己的文档指出，仅由克劳德校对或翻译的人类文本就可以达到这一标准。

sentences.en: And absence proves even less: old models or heavy editing yield clean results on genuine AI text.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，缺席的情况更少：旧模型或大量编辑可以在真正的人工智能文本上产生干净的结果。

blocks.html_en: • Short and low-choice text carries little mark. Evidence grows with length, and text with only one right continuation (code, quotations, lists of facts) offers the dice too little slack to hide anything in.

sentences.en: Short and low-choice text carries little mark.
sentences.zh: 简短而低选择的文本几乎没有什么意义。

sentences.en: Evidence grows with length, and text with only one right continuation (code, quotations, lists of facts) offers the dice too little slack to hide anything in.
sentences.zh: 证据随着长度的增加而增长，而只有一个正确的延续（代码、引文、事实列表）的文本给骰子提供了太小的松弛度，无法隐藏任何东西。

blocks.html_en: • Certain marks outlive a rewrite. Schemes keyed on the word itself rather than its neighbours hold up far better: a same-meaning rewrite keeps enough of the words that much of the mark survives. (Their weakness is different: a colouring reused everywhere can be reverse-engineered from enough output.) Others hide in the meaning, and a same-meaning rewrite partly preserves them; the only answer we know there is outline-level regeneration.

sentences.en: Certain marks outlive a rewrite.
sentences.zh: 某些标记比重写更有效。

sentences.en: Schemes keyed on the word itself rather than its neighbours hold up far better: a same-meaning rewrite keeps enough of the words that much of the mark survives.
sentences.zh: 以单词本身而不是其邻居为重点的方案效果要好得多：相同含义的重写保留了足够的单词，从而使大部分标记得以保留。

sentences.en: (Their weakness is different: a colouring reused everywhere can be reverse-engineered from enough output.)
sentences.zh: （它们的弱点是不同的：可以从足够的输出中对到处重复使用的颜色进行逆向工程。）

sentences.en: Others hide in the meaning, and a same-meaning rewrite partly preserves them; the only answer we know there is outline-level regeneration.
sentences.zh: 其他隐藏在含义中，相同含义的重写会部分保留它们；我们知道的唯一答案是大纲级再生。

blocks.html_en: Written by James Padolsey at NOPE as an accompaniment to declaude. The interactive figures are a teaching model with illustrative parameters, not any provider's actual scheme.

sentences.en: Written by James Padolsey at NOPE as an accompaniment to declaude.
sentences.zh: 由 James Padolsey 在 NOPE 创作，作为 declade 的伴奏。

sentences.en: The interactive figures are a teaching model with illustrative parameters, not any provider's actual scheme.
sentences.zh: 交互式图形是带有说明性参数的教学模型，并非任何提供者的实际方案。

sentences.zh: 来源和进一步阅读。

sentences.zh: （2023）·Zhao 等人，The Mark Fades：基于自适应进化释义的攻击（ACL 发现 2026）·Anthropic，Claude 如何标记 AI 生成的内容（帮助中心，2026 年 8 月）·我们自己的已知关键实验：重新组合使 KGW/EXP 检测崩溃（AUC 0.99 → ≈0.5），上下文无关的一元标记得以幸存（0.73–0.84）；轮廓级再生是我们所知道的意义空间标记的唯一答案。

blocks.html_en: For the specialist: the residual-evidence model behind the step-4 verdict is z ≈ f·√N·z₁ (surviving fraction f, document length N, per-token strength z₁). The figures count words; real detectors count tokens in the model's own tokenizer. Same shape.

sentences.en: For the specialist: the residual-evidence model behind the step-4 verdict is z ≈ f·√N·z₁ (surviving fraction f, document length N, per-token strength z₁).
sentences.zh: 对于专家来说：第 4 步判决背后的剩余证据模型是 z ≈ f·√N·z₁（幸存分数 f、文档长度 N、每个令牌强度 z₁）。

sentences.en: The figures count words; real detectors count tokens in the model's own tokenizer.
sentences.zh: 数字计算字数；真实的检测器在模型自己的标记器中计算标记。

sentences.en: Same shape.
sentences.zh: 形状相同。

content_html_zh:
← 声明

纯文本水印听起来不可能。 文本没有可隐藏数据的像素，复制粘贴后也无法保存任何元数据；每个角色就在你面前。 一个标记可能会去哪里？

但这些痕迹是真实的。 自 2024 年以来，Google 就对 Gemini 应用程序和网络体验中的文本添加了水印（在撰写本文时，其 API 已记录为例外情况），截至 2026 年 8 月，新的 Claude 模型在模型级别标记文本，早期模型也将效仿。 它们是看不见的，它们在复制中幸存下来，它们之所以有效，是因为它们根本不存在于角色中。 他们生活在词语之间的选择中。

1. 写作是一系列的小选择

这一步的一个想法是：模型通过在几个单词之间滚动加权骰子来进行写入，每个单词都可以。

当模型处于句子中间时，它不知道“下一个单词”。 它有一个候选列表，就像自动完成一样，带有偏好。 这是一个真实的时刻，一个句子末尾的一个词：

正在写的句子

研究结果相当

每掷一次都会扫过候选名单，落在一个单词上（与条形匹配的赔率）并将其放入上面的句子中。 这些点记录了掷骰子的落点：尝试×20，观察掷骰子的形状。 请注意永远不会改变的事情：每次着陆都会造就一个完美的句子。

一页文本包含数百个这样的小叉子，每个单词一个，并且其中许多选项都同样可以。 这种松弛就是原材料。 无论谁掌握了骰子落地的方式，都可以在不改变文本内容的情况下隐藏文本中的模式。

2. 秘密钥匙取决于这些选择

这一步的一个想法是：关键秘密地为入围名单着色，并轻轻推动一种颜色。 文字仍能正常阅读。

这是经典的秘诀（Kirchenbauer et al. 2023；Google 的 SynthID 通过一种更微妙的锦标赛风格的路线达到了同样的目的）。 在每个分叉处，秘密密钥数学将候选单词分成绿色和红色，这是只有密钥持有者才能重现的任意颜色。 然后骰子稍微向绿色倾斜。

正在写的句子

研究结果相当

未应用密钥：这些是模型自己的偏好。 一旦按键打开，虚线轮廓将显示旧赔率。

有两件事让这件事变得狡猾。 这种推动是温和的：红色词仍然可以获胜——只是可能性较小。 并且颜色不是单词的固定属性：键根据之前单词的一小部分来计算它，因此相同的候选者在一个前缀之后是绿色的，在另一个前缀之后是红色的：

相同的四个候选词，由六个不同前缀后的键着色。 钥匙看到了前面的单词；较宽文本中的位置对它来说是不可见的。 只有整体的绿色倾向不断积累，只有关键持有者才知道哪些词在哪里是绿色的。

（两兄妹，原则相同。 谷歌的 SynthID（正在生产中的那个）用一个小型的秘密锦标赛取代了推动：从模型自己的赔率中抽取一些候选者，关键对它们进行评分，然后排列括号，以便对关键抽签进行平均，每个单词的赔率完全符合模型的预期。 Aaronson 的方案是在 OpenAI 上构建的，甚至跳过了这一点，并从密钥中推导出骰子本身。 不同的数学，相同的原理：分数存在于选择中。）

3. 谁掌握了钥匙，谁就可以数数

这一步的一个想法是：使用 key，您可以为任何文本重新着色并简单地计数。 标记的文本经常变成绿色，这并不是运气。

检测不会读取文本或判断其风格。 检测器会重放钥匙扣在单词上的颜色，并计算有多少个单词显示为绿色。 如果没有标记（或没有正确的钥匙），绿色应该赢得大约一半的机会。 抛硬币。 这是一个看起来很普通的段落；尝试使用两个键：

果岭： – 55

抛硬币

4. 编辑对标记有何作用

这一步的一个想法是：标记存在于一系列未受影响的措辞中。 编辑会准确地删除运行中断的地方，而不是其他地方。

每个单词的颜色都源自其之前的一小部分单词（一个到几个，具体取决于方案）。 因此，只有原始措辞（该词及其相邻词）的一小部分完好无损地保留下来，该立场才算作证据。

这是步骤 3 中的同一段落，有五个编辑深度。 拖动滑块并观察突出显示的运行缩小。 突出显示意味着该行文字仍然与原始文字完全匹配，因此检测器可以在那里进行计数。 一切褪色的都是新的措辞，除了抛硬币的噪音之外什么也没有。

修复拼写错误·幸存窗口：–%

判决书读取了根据上述要点测量的幸存分数，并将其投影到一份 1,500 字的文档中。 需要注意两件事：“大量编辑”留下了多少痕迹，以及在证据真正消亡之前你必须拖到完全重写的程度。

在实际实现中（MarkLLM 在开放模型上的 KGW 和 EXP 方案，由 declaude 的完全重写路线清洗）：大约 0.5% 的窗口幸存下来，检测器精度从基本确定下降到抛硬币。 已发表的文献对此的形式表示同意。 轻微或一次性的释义会淡化标记，而不是删除它；在 Kirchenbauer 等人的实验中，检测器可以在给定足够文本的情况下恢复，甚至在大约 800 个标记（约 600 个单词）后，甚至可以再次检测到人类的释义。 消除标记的是重新构图，与原作没有任何措辞。

这就是为什么从含义重写的工具（如 declaude 的完全重写路线）实际上会删除这组标记，而保留大部分措辞的轻量级却不会。

一个界限清楚地表明：这些数字来自我们可以测量的开放实现。 Anthropic 的生产方案尚未公开，因此 Anthropic 之外的任何人都无法针对 Claude 自己的标记进行这项测试。

5. 这在实践中意味着什么

这一步的一个想法是：检测是私密的、概率性的，并且是关于处理的，而不是作者身份。

  • 只有钥匙持有者才能检查。 您的老师、编辑或最喜欢的“AI 检测器”网站无法运行此测试；真正的检查需要提供者的密钥，或者提供者运行的检查服务。 Google 为 SynthID 运行了一个早期访问检测器门户； Anthropic 表示检测工具即将推出。
  • 水印检查不是“人工智能检测器”。 像 GPTZero 这样的工具会根据风格进行猜测，并且众所周知是不可靠的。 水印则相反：一种经过深思熟虑的、关键门控的统计测试。 别让两者混淆了。
  • 找到的标记意味着“由……处理”，而不是“由……编写”。 Anthropic 自己的文档指出，仅由克劳德校对或翻译的人类文本就可以达到这一标准。 事实证明，缺席的情况更少：旧模型或大量编辑可以在真正的人工智能文本上产生干净的结果。
  • 简短而低选择的文本几乎没有什么意义。 证据随着长度的增加而增长，而只有一个正确的延续（代码、引文、事实列表）的文本给骰子提供了太小的松弛度，无法隐藏任何东西。
  • 某些标记比重写更有效。 以单词本身而不是其邻居为重点的方案效果要好得多：相同含义的重写保留了足够的单词，从而使大部分标记得以保留。 （它们的弱点是不同的：可以从足够的输出中对到处重复使用的颜色进行逆向工程。） 其他隐藏在含义中，相同含义的重写会部分保留它们；我们知道的唯一答案是大纲级再生。
